title: About the archive
lead: The State Archive of East Kazakhstan Region is a municipal state institution under the region's Department of Digitalization and Archives. Since 1940 it has collected, kept and described records on the history of the region.

facts.newspapers: newspaper titles in the newspaper collection

work.title: What the archive does
work.text: The archive takes in records of the region's organisations and residents, keeps them safe and registered, appraises the value of documents, prepares finding aids and publications, receives researchers in the reading room and issues archival certificates.
work.unitsText: The department names show the main lines of work. Heads, phone numbers and e-mail are on the structure page.

store.title: Custody
store.text: Accepts records of the region's organisations and citizens and keeps them safe.

account.title: State registration
account.text: Keeps the register of fonds, inventories and case files.

appraisal.title: Appraisal
appraisal.text: Decides which records are kept permanently.

reference.title: Finding aids and publications
reference.text: Prepares guides, collections and document exhibitions.

readingRoom.title: Reading room
readingRoom.text: Receives researchers and issues case files for study.

certificates.title: Archival certificates
certificates.text: Confirms employment, salary and other facts from the records.
